cohort: The study included 79 patients with pathologically confirmed retroperitoneal schwannoma who underwent tumor resection between June 2010 and June 2020.
finding: Cystic degeneration in retroperitoneal schwannoma was significantly associated with multiple foci, calcification, and hemorrhage, but not with tumor size, Ki-67, or malignancy; malignant retroperitoneal schwannoma was associated with multiple lymph node enlargement and always recurred.
